source_visual_changes: Uniform opaque white 768×768 canvas, black 1 pt geometry, prescribed fonts and source-informed labels.

All solid geometry is constructed in true 3D and projected through one frozen camera. Source sketch distortions, decorative lighting and inconsistent hidden-line styles are normalized without weakening the protocol.
A fixed x=1 realization preserves the parallel section. L is exactly 24, so its answer type is number rather than expression.

answer_verification.source_answer_conflict: Section parallel to base must be stated rather than inferred solely from drawing.

geometry_notes.visibility_derivation: Each edge is split at all projected face-boundary intersections. For each open interval a 3D ray toward_viewer is tested against every face plane and its true polygon. Adjacent equal states merged. Source-omitted hidden edges are retained in model but not drawn.
